paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -3.36% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (-1.65%) and DAX weakest (-4.74%). Brent crude changed -6.67% to 86.27. Gold changed -5.45% to 3,643.0. Bitcoin changed -4.61% to 60,084.2695. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.918%, a relative move of -3.96%. Among the firms tracked, Glencore (-11.93%) and Freeport-McMoRan (-9.93%) moved the most.
